Despite Nice Nature's hard-fought efforts, 
she couldn't reach Tokai Teio in the Japan 
Derby.

Furthermore, Tokai Teio overflowed with 
motivation, determined to train even 
harder toward her next race.

Seeing her like that, Nice Nature looked 
on with envy, thinking that Tokai Teio was 
truly the kind of person born to stand 
under the spotlight.
